name: ANSI/IEEE dc generator symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for dc generator, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The DC generator form identifies a documented source of direct-current output. Polarity and excitation connections establish how the generated circuit supplies its load, while the mechanical prime mover is referenced separately.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read source polarity before tracing downstream DC distribution.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A DC source-generating function differs from a DC motor load despite related machine principles.
